subject: group chat people

hook.say: Every group chat has these four people. You are at least two.

types.name: The Ghost
types.say: Reads every message. Replies in the next financial year.

types.name: The Sticker Gremlin
types.say: No words. Just a frog holding a knife.

types.name: The Organiser
types.say: Trying to arrange a meet-up since March.

kicker.say: You are at least two of these. You know which.

caption: Send this to the friend who is all four. They know who they are.

subject: people at every wedding

hook.say: Every wedding has these four people. One of them is you.

types.name: The Crier
types.say: Started at the vows. Hasn't stopped. It's the speeches now.

types.name: The DJ
types.say: Has one playlist. It is 2011. Nobody has told him.

types.name: The Aunt With The Phone
types.say: Filming vertically. The whole ceremony. From the front row.

types.name: The Uninvited
types.say: Arrived. Brought a plus one. Brought a chair.

kicker.say: You are one of them. You cried. Admit it.

caption: There is always one aunt filming the whole thing vertically.
